structure.unit: Forest Resources and the Department of Forestry

law.catch_line: Office of Working Lands Preservation established

text.section: The Office of Working Lands Preservation is established in the Department of Forestry under the supervision of the State Forester.
As used in this article, unless the context requires a different meaning: "Fund" means the Virginia Farmland and Forestland Preservation Fund. "Office" means the Office of Working Lands Preservation.
